outline:
高分子流變學
本課程以講述高分子流體之黏性及彈性為主。內容包括:
(1) 黏彈性簡介(2)時間溫度轉換(3)非結晶區之玻璃轉移點(4)橡膠理論
(5)黏彈模型(6)介電鬆弛等專題。
This course will extensively study the viscosity and elasticity of polymeric materials. The main contents include
(1) Phenomenalogical Treatment of Viscoelasticity
(2) Time-Temperature Correspondence
(3) Transitions and Relaxation in Amorphous Polymers
(4) Rubber Elasticity
(5) Viscoelastic Models
(6) Dielectric Relaxation
schedule:
01 Organic Material Introduction
02 Polymer Introduction

05 Fluid Mechanics
06 Viscosity Measurement
07 Viscoelasticity Modelling and Application
08 Viscoelasticity
09 Rheology Review
10 Mid Term.Exam
11 Suspension Rheology
12 Coating Rheology
13 Rubber Elasticity
14 Fracture Mechanics
15 Polymer Processing
16 Paper Report
17 Paper Report
18. Final Exam.
